::: {.section-title}
What is OSGeo Indonesia?
:::

::: {.section-subtitle}
We are the Indonesian local chapter of the Open Source Geospatial Foundation (OSGeo), dedicated to promoting and supporting the development of open source geospatial technologies across the archipelago.
:::

### Open Source GIS
Promoting powerful open source GIS tools like QGIS, GRASS GIS, and PostGIS for mapping and spatial analysis across Indonesia.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
::: {.card-icon}
👥

### Community Building
Connecting geospatial professionals, researchers, students, and enthusiasts throughout Indonesia's diverse islands.
:::

::: {.feature-card}
::: {.card-icon}
📚
:::

### Education & Training
Providing workshops, tutorials, and resources to build geospatial capacity using open source tools.

::: {.section-title}
Featured Projects
:::

::: {.section-subtitle}
Open source geospatial tools that power Indonesia's mapping and spatial data infrastructure.
:::

::: {.grid style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(350px, 1fr)); gap: 1.5rem;"}

::: {.project-card}
#### QGIS
A free and open source geographic information system for creating, editing, visualizing, and analyzing geospatial data. Widely used across Indonesian government agencies and universities.
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### PostGIS
Spatial database extender for PostgreSQL. Powers many of Indonesia's geospatial data infrastructures and web mapping services.
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### GeoServer
An open source server for sharing geospatial data. Used for publishing Indonesia's spatial data through OGC standards.
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### OpenStreetMap
The free, editable map of the world. Indonesia has one of the most active OSM communities globally.
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### GDAL/OGR
The essential translator library for raster and vector geospatial data formats, supporting hundreds of formats.
:::

::: {.project-card}
#### GeoNode
A web-based platform for developing geospatial information systems and deploying spatial data infrastructures.
:::

:::

:::
